research.title: DimFlux
research.description: Force-directed additive line diagrams for concept lattices, by projecting DimDraw layouts into the additive space and applying forces to maximize the conflict distance between nodes and non-incident edges.

research.title: Node Labeling
research.description: A two-phase algorithm for labeling line diagrams of ordered sets, placing labels without intersecting nodes, lines, or other labels while minimizing distances to their nodes.

sideProjects.title: LEGO Brick Sorting Machine
sideProjects.description: A LEGO brick sorting machine using a vibratory plate for separation, visual color detection and magnetic valves that trigger compressed air bursts to sort bricks quickly and precisely by color.

sideProjects.title: Rocket League Overlay
sideProjects.description: A dynamic streaming overlay for Rocket League Esports matches, designed to read and seamlessly display in-game data. It also includes a caster panel for easy adjustment of match information.

sideProjects.title: Swagger For AAS
sideProjects.description: Reads data from Asset Administration Shells, generalizes it, and generates a comprehensive Swagger UI documentation to ensure clarity and accessibility for developers.

sideProjects.title: Webmaster MVB
sideProjects.description: A website for a local music club, where we design and display news, manage email communication, and handle various online tasks to keep the community informed and engaged.
